# MuJoCo Menagerie model subset

Source: https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie

Upstream commit: `370c43965323c0944b433b202aac5058b5f907a9`

Only `universal_robots_ur5e`, `robotiq_2f85`, and `realsense_d435i` are included because these are the models loaded by this project. Their files are unchanged. The upstream root `LICENSE` and each model's own `LICENSE` are preserved here.
